description: Get detailed information about a specific DeFi vault including risk breakdown, recent events, and historical snapshots. Lookup by ID or by network + address.

address.description: Vault address in the chain's namespace: 0x-hex on EVM chains, base58 (case-sensitive) on Solana

network.description: Network slug from the chain registry (e.g. ethereum, base, arbitrum, solana). /v1/chains lists slugs for chains with active vaults.

name: get_vault
